title: Study to Evaluate Smecta® vs Placebo on the Time to Recovery Following an Acute Diarrhoea Episode in Adults
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate whether Smecta® is more effective than placebo with respect to time to recovery following an acute diarrhoea episode.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Acute diarrhoea episode defined as at least 3 watery stools per day for 48 hours or less
* Patient with, usually, normal bowel habits, i.e. at least 3 stools per week and no more than 3 stools per day

Exclusion Criteria:

* Gross blood, pus in the stools
* Fever \>39ºC
* Other episode of acute watery diarrhoea within the last 30 days
* History of chronic diarrhoea or motor diarrhoea
